nom: Avène Hyaluron Activ B3 Renewal Firming Cream

avis.texte: This cream was not as hoped. bought it to use as a day cream and was so super pilly that I had to take a paper towel to gently whisk away the pills. They were all in my bronzer brush. Not much moisture either especially after whisking away the pills.
This works well, its so hydrating and makes my skin feel amazing. It does have a fragrance for those sensitive, but it doesn't bother me.

Not sure why all the bad reviews. I received a sample frim Ulta and immediately purchased a full-size bottle of the moisturizer and serum. Both products didn't have any fragrance. They work well. I don't wear makeup daily so i can say how well this product works under makeup, but i am loving it so far.

I love the ingredient list and the texture/feel of this cream. However, added fragrance irritates my eyes and this one very much did. I hope Avene would consider making this fragrance-free like the B3 serum in the future.
This doesnt feel like it has any useful ingredients. Your skin doesn't feel good after putting it on. It's tooo fragranced and dry. I wish I returned it.
I have bought it several times and I use it in combination with the vitamin C serum. It is fabulous!
I was not impressed with this moisturizer. It's fragrance was so so strong and it didn't feel hydrating at all.

This would be a wonderful and effective moisturizer but why on earth would Avene add perfume/fragrance to it? I love the Avene products that do not contain fragrance. The Retrinal 0.01 is one of the best retinaldehyde creams ever formulated. I can use that because there is no fragrance/parfum in it. Fragrance in skincare is a known allergen and can be very problematic for skin.

The AvÃ¨ne Hyaluron Activ B3 Renewal Firming Cream is incredibly hydrating and feels luxurious on the skin. With my combination skin, it sinks in nicely without leaving a greasy residue. Over time, my skin has felt firmer and more plump, especially around fine lines. The addition of hyaluronic acid and niacinamide makes it a solid pick for anyone looking for both hydration and anti-aging benefits. Perfect for daily use under makeup or at night for an extra boost.
It's a nice and light serum that's watery and not oily. Plumps up my skin and makes it more hydrated. No harsh scent either

avis.titre: Pills like mad. Don't waste your money.
avis.texte: This is the worst Avene product of all the products I've tried. It pills immediately as immediately as I'm applying. If there's a trick to applying this product so it doesn't pill, please tell me. I will not be buying this product again.

I wanted to love this product bevause of the dermatologist that I follow on instagram. The alcohol and fragrance on the ingredient list made me question buying it. I shouldnt have. 😂 i got like allergy bumps that itch on my face. They are red and small but ugh. I was trying something new and I shouldnt have.

This delicately fragrance moisturizer is so gentle on the skin. A little goes a long way and it forms a cushioned moisture barrier on skin. Applying makeup on top is easy. Occasionally I noticed a little pilling with foundation near my hairline, but nothing I couldn't blend out. I have had reactions or sensitivities and my skin stays nicely hydrated on it.

I bought it a few months ago for the first time. I've been using Avene for years now and I absolutely adore some of their products. This one is an absolute miss, unfortunately. It makes me sweat, leaves a very thick layer on my skin and creates rolls of dirt that I can simply remove from my face. I've used it a handful of times because of the way it makes my skin look like.
I have used this on my face a few times, but I am not a fan. It pills so much. I used it at night, but I don't think it would pair well with makeup because of the pilling.
So far, so good. Nothing major noted in using it for a while but it may take more time.
I tried the Hyaluron Activ B3 Concentrated Plumping Serum. Overall I think it works really well. I will continue my journey with it.
The firming cream with the serum work excellent together. My face looks lively when I use both together. I've even had a few compliments. It's nice to hear when your face looks tired half the time.
I received this product to try. It is a great product!. I definitely recommend.
I used this cream during my nighttime routine as the second layer after the Hyaluron serum. It kept my complexion soft and supple. A small dose of application goes a long way, so a good investment!

I've only used this cream a few days and have already noticed a change in the texture and firmness of my skin. I plan to replace my previous cream with this one and hope to continue to reap the benefits.
First off..A whole jar!! Ty ty ty ..this stuff is amazing. My face felt so hydrated after the first time trying it. This will be my go to from now on.. Thank you again ☺️

I have tried many moisturizing creams in years since I started my skin care routine, and I can say that this is one of my favorites. The hydration it gives my skin is simply incomparable. I have very dry skin and I loved it from the first use.
I love this cream! It goes on smoothly and does not irritate my sometimes sensitive skin. My skin looks brighter and smoother.
Poor quality. The condition of the cream was so poorly made that it didn't even moisturize.

I really love how much this product makes my face skin feel. My face feels moisturized and smooth. After using this for a week day and night my skin has less noticeable lines .I'm going to continue to use AVene renewal firming cream.

This would be great for people with dry skin. It was a little too heavy for me with my oily skin but it may be better during the winter when I need the extra boost of moisture. I added a water spritz and that helped with absorption issues. It felt really good and has ingredients for firming the skin.
I was given the opportunity to try out this product and love it! Smells great and leaves my face feeling fresh ! Will definitely be on my must have list!

avis.titre: Hyaluron Active B3 Renewal Firming Cream
avis.texte: Easy to apply, gentle, absorbs quickly. This has a slight, but enjoyable scent. I will be looking for more of this product.

I picked up this cream for the first time from a pharmacy in Paris last year and I love it. Thick and creamy with no scent. It deeply moisturizes my face. I was happy to find it available for purchase in the States.

This skin care brand came to my aid when I had an eczema outbreak on my face. I religiously used their calming bomb and sensitive eye cream, and my face was clear in a week. I was so amazed by the product that I started to venture in other products they've had, I'm blown away that this product hasn't gone viral yet. Just using the serum with this moisturizer alone, I can see a major difference in my face in the last three days completely out my skin tone and smooth the texture of my skin. My face feels firmer and more hydrated, this applies beautifully under make up. I would compare this line with Chanel or Dior.
The texture of the cream is amazing! Can't wait to try the other products in the collection.

avis.titre: Skin is soft and plump, I like the light scent
avis.texte: My tired-look aging Mom of 2 young kids skin needed a boost and this one is it. I loved the ingredients in this cream so it got me to try. It has a light scent/smell that's very nice. It made my dull dry skin feel ultra-hydrated and plumped. My skin gets so sensitive and this was fine for me. I've been using it for a few weeks and can see the difference in my skin so far. I want to try a Serum next!
